name: Cos☆Para ~Happy Costume☆Paradise~
original_name: コス☆パラ～はっぴぃコスチューム☆パラダイス～
source:
Main character is the son of a director of a huge department store chain. He is entrusted to hold a beauty competition among store clerks. And in accordance to father's tastes it should be a cosplay competition. The concurs outcome will determine the position protagonist achieves in the company.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家大型百货连锁企业董事长的儿子。他受命为商场员工举办一场选美比赛。而且根据父亲的喜好，这必须是一场角色扮演大赛。比赛的最终结果，将直接决定主人公在公司里能够获得怎样的职位。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
